collections.method: Viewed both overview sheets and the four listed full-resolution examples. Other priority derivatives were inventoried but are not claimed as individually inspected.

collections.identityAssessment: The capture manifest identifies an October 19 source, different from the October 18 main drive. Its two residential windows are separate short patches, the shared view-plan uses arbitrary scene units, and the delivery record says one physical street side and recommends measured landmarks before cross-pass geometry claims. No GPS coordinates or georeference were found in these reviewed metadata. Visible houses/yard details are scenery references only; they cannot be assigned to main-recording building IDs.

matches.label: 22 Cricket Place red-brick porch house with orange-wheeled toy (source seconds 870 and 900)
matches.evidence: The user explicitly identifies the red-brick porch house beside the orange-wheeled toy in the t=870/900 recording view as 22 Cricket Place. The official City civic parcel query returns ADDRESS=22 CRICKET PL (MapServer/4 objectId 4384); OSM way/1015118649 has centroid (-78.311336411,44.307332789) inside that parcel and all 8 listed vertices inside. The exact frontage parcel is therefore tied to this mapped building, not inferred from appearance alone. Source pixels show red brick, pale front-gable trim, broad green porch canopy, porch columns/white rail, front lawn with shrubs/flower beds, a concrete walk, and a front-yard gravel/asphalt drive; no roof, height or geometry edit is implied.
matches.reason: Exact address confirmation plus civic parcel geometry resolves the house identity. Detached-garage geometry way/1015118650 is not a façade target; its centroid is in parcel 22 but its outline straddles the 22/24 parcel boundary. Keep its appearance unchanged absent independent source pixels.
matches.candidateStreet: Cricket Place (confirmed by sign, route and official parcel address)

matches.label: Cricket Place street-name anchor at the Driscoll Terrace junction
matches.evidence: The Cricket Pl and STOP signs at t=936 are on the same corner as the distinctive twin-evergreen beige house and blank red-brick wall seen across the junction in t=840 lens0 and again in t=930/936 lens1. The OSM western node 388924251 is a vehicle junction joining Cricket Place way/33960427, Driscoll Terrace ways/33965578 and /33938730, plus service way/827183682. Quaker Park way/1020094081 and wooded/open ground are nearby. This visual+topology sequence identifies the stop-sign junction as the western Cricket/Driscoll junction with high confidence. Cricket Place eastern endpoint node 388970236 joins only footways /827185081 and /827185082, so it is not the photographed vehicle junction.
matches.candidateAssessment: These are nearby unaddressed footprints only; listed as a review neighborhood, not photo-to-building matches.
matches.endpointConfidence: high: reciprocal distinctive scene match plus OSM vehicle-junction topology; no GPS coordinates are present in the frames

matches.label: Green-gabled red-brick house immediately west of 22 Cricket Place
matches.evidence: The green-gabled brick house appears at t=864 lens0 outbound and again at t=918 lens1 on the return. The confirmed route runs west-to-east from Driscoll onto Cricket, places this frontage just before the confirmed 22 Cricket Place porch house at t=870, and passes it again on return. OSM way/1015118648 is the immediately west-adjacent north-side footprint relative to the confirmed 22 parcel. This ordered visual/map match is strong but lacks a civic address parcel confirmation for this house; keep it provisional.

matches.label: 24 Cricket Place adjacent white-porch brick house
matches.evidence: The official City parcel query returns ADDRESS=24 CRICKET PL (MapServer/4 objectId 4385), the immediately east-adjoining lot in the confirmed eastbound Cricket sequence. Local OSM way/1015118651 has centroid (-78.311216611,44.307438667) inside that parcel; 7/9 vertices are also inside. The t=870 lens0 frame shows the adjacent red-brick frontage with pale gable trim, green porch canopy, white porch rail/columns, two clearly visible upper front windows, a front lawn, shrubs, concrete entry walk and driveway. Its adjacency/order from the user-confirmed route and parcel overlap support the 24 frontage match.

Detached brick and pale-sided houses, short lawns, concrete sidewalks, narrow entrance walks, gravel/asphalt drives, mature street trees and parked cars. Cricket Pl street-name sign and STOP sign mark a residential-street corner by a large blank red-brick side wall; the visible Cricket Pl and STOP signs, reciprocal twin-evergreen/brick-wall landmarks, and OSM topology identify the western Cricket/Driscoll vehicle junction. Neighbor frames show asphalt approach, a concrete curb ramp and sidewalk, small landscaped traffic island with grass, low planting against the wall, parked cars, streetlights, utility poles and overhead wires. The 14:30 and 15:00 frames show detached two-storey brick houses, pale gables, green porch roof, short front lawns, shrubs/flower beds, concrete entry walks, gravel drives, a small shed/garage, and parked cars. The confirmed route proceeds east from the Driscoll junction to the 22/24 Cricket Place frontage and returns west; this home/neighbor match follows the user-confirmed turn sequence and official civic parcels.

The t=870/900 orange-toy brick-porch house is confirmed as 22 Cricket Place, OSM way/1015118649, by official civic parcel objectId 4384 and in-parcel OSM overlap; the adjacent t=870 white-porch house is 24 Cricket Place, way/1015118651, civic parcel objectId 4385. lateRouteGap.endpointComparison: High confidence: t=840 lens0 and t=930/936 lens1 show reciprocal views of the same distinctive twin-evergreen beige house, blank brick wall, curb and landscaped/open island; t=936 lens0 reads Cricket Pl beside STOP. OSM west node 388924251 joins Cricket Place way/33960427, Driscoll Terrace ways/33965578 and /33938730, and service way/827183682. The east node 388970236 connects Cricket only to footways /827185081 and /827185082, so it cannot be the photographed vehicle intersection. The sign, reciprocal landmarks and road topology identify the western Cricket/Driscoll junction; frames contain no GPS.

decision: Two frontage identities are now confirmed: 22 Cricket Place maps to OSM way/1015118649, and adjacent 24 Cricket Place maps to way/1015118651, each via official City civic parcel geometry and local OSM footprint overlap. Frame evidence supports bounded façade cues for both houses. The green-gabled red-brick house immediately west is likely way/1015118648 from the user-confirmed route and outbound/return order but remains provisional. Way/1015118650 is an ancillary parcel-overlap/possible garage footprint without independent façade pixels; leave it unchanged. Existing Shoppers Drug Mart match remains represented; Walmart and McDonalds remain site-signage references. Civic parcel front boundaries for 22 and 24 Cricket Place are stored as mapped endpoint coordinates in this audit. The 22 parcel matches OSM way/1015118649; the 24 parcel matches way/1015118651. Way/1015118648 remains the provisional green-gable west neighbor.
limitations: The experimental fisheye calibration and projections are visual reference output, not surveyed geometry or reliable photometric color measurement.
